verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's pricing page (clickhouse.com/pricing) is referenced with statements that compute and storage are billed separately and scale to zero when idle, and that autoscaling limits exist to cap bills — indicating a usage-based, unit-driven billing model. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit per-unit rate figures (e.g. $/compute-unit-hour, $/GB-storage, $/GB-egress) that a founder could use to actually compute a bill in advance, and traffic/network pricing specifics are not mentioned at all. missing for 10: explicit published $ rates for compute, storage, and data-transfer/traffic, and a documented example bill calculation.
